summary: MDI’s first-property configuration should use role-based, property-scoped access; separate rent from required utilities in advertised pricing; retain first-of-month current-month billing while permitting scheduled payments on the 25th; apply a company-wide rent-first allocation order; keep collectible former-resident balances open; disable accelerated rent; automate month-to-month charges using the system rent charge code; use tracked vanity numbers with Leasing AI; retain Tenant Tech but generate leases manually until its document defects are resolved; and enable Facilities Pro work assignment. Later calls supersede earlier uncertainty on rent-first allocation, manual renewal generation, manual lease generation and invoice approvers. Partial-payment policy and maintenance auto-assignment remain unresolved because later calls exposed portfolio-wide side effects and property-dependent workflows.

callsUsed.title: MDI Final Accounting Call
callsUsed.brief: Taylor from Entrata, along with Stacy from MDI Management, discussed optimizing invoice approval workflows, addressing issues with check printing and the "post month" field, and outlining future support resources. They agreed on a new group-based approval system for invoices and refunds, and Taylor provided solutions for printing checks and acknowledged the "post month" field as a common pain point. The call concluded with a positive outlook on Entrata's reporting features and the transition to self-service support.

callsUsed.title: Hannah | JJ
callsUsed.brief: JJ from Entrata, along with Hannah from MDI Management, discussed the challenges MDI was facing with mapping merge fields between Entrata and Tenant Tech for lease agreements, leading to manual data entry. JJ committed to investigating and resolving the mapping issues, acknowledging the current process was inefficient and assuring MDI that they would not be solely responsible for fixing it. The call concluded with a plan for MDI to provide examples of leases with incorrect or missing information to aid in troubleshooting.
